purpose: Records the exact machine + tooling for the v1.5 unified benchmark, and the gates that are BLOCKED in this environment. Per v1.5 §3/§19 every result JSON references this file. Node/happy-dom numbers are NEVER presented as browser numbers.

measurementTooling.bundler: esbuild 0.24.2 (measurement only; never a streetui runtime dependency)

browserGate.chromium: none — no Chromium/Chrome browser binary present anywhere. Checked CHROMIUM_PATH, /usr/bin/{chromium,chromium-browser,google-chrome,google-chrome-stable}, the Playwright browser cache (~/.cache/ms-playwright), and a full filesystem sweep: no executable found (only apparmor/bash-completion text files match the name). apt has no chromium install candidate offline; the Playwright-bundled build cannot be downloaded (cdn.playwright.dev unreachable, npm/registry 403).
browserGate.playwright: PACKAGE is present but UNUSABLE for browser measurement. The observed package version is UNSTABLE across process invocations in this VM (both 1.49.1 — the pin — and 1.63.0 have been seen on different runs; the node_modules state swaps between sandbox calls). In EVERY observed case the browser binary is absent: playwright's chromium.executablePath() (e.g. ~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome or chromium-1148/chrome-linux/chrome) does not exist, and an actual chromium.launch() FAILS with 'Executable doesn't exist'. `playwright install chromium` would fetch Chrome Headless Shell ~153.0.8010.12 from cdn.playwright.dev, which is network-blocked here. The unified runner records whichever version it observes live at run time.
browserGate.fabricationCrossReference: The build Playwright 1.63.0 WOULD download is Chrome Headless Shell 153.0.8010.12 (aka 'Chromium 153'). That is exactly the 'Chromium 153 / Playwright 1.63.0' pair a prior fabricated report revision cited as if a browser had run. Those strings came from Playwright's version manifest, NOT from any executed benchmark — the binary was never downloaded and a real launch fails.
browserGate.consequence: v1.5 §3/§5/§7/§8/§18 real-browser scenarios still cannot execute. The unified runner detects the missing browser binary (not merely the package) and writes BLOCKED result files with the exact reason; it never fabricates or substitutes a happy-dom number for a browser number.

competitorGate.pinPolicy: Exact versions, no ^/~. These are BENCHMARK-ONLY dev deps and MUST NEVER be added to streetui runtime dependencies.
competitorGate.consequence: No cross-framework numbers are produced. Missing Svelte (and all other) numbers are NOT filled in. No happy-dom vs Chromium mixing. No ranking.

antiFabricationPolicy: Every number in v1.5 comes from a command executed in this environment. Unavailable data (browser, competitor, publish) is recorded BLOCKED with the exact reason — never estimated, substituted, or copied across environments. This file supersedes the fabricated browser/competitor/publish claims that a prior revision of the v1.4 report contained (see V1.4 report correction notice).
